lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [tired] At midnight, I was almost done. Twelve islands. Three hundred bubbles. One very tired builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [uneasy] Then my game started... lagging.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.text: [slow, deep, glitchy] Mmm... bub... bub... bubbles.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [startled] Who said that?!

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.text: [slow, deep, glitchy] I... am... [long pause] ...the LAAAG.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.text: [hungry, slow] More players... more... rushing... more... FOOD.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [brave, shaky] Get out of my game! This is MY game!

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.text: [slow, mocking] Your... game... has... three... visits. [pause] Nobody... will... miss... it.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [hurt, quiet] ...Rude.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [whispering, scared] And then my cat... lagged. In REAL LIFE.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [grave, quiet] So. He's back.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [shocked] Grandpa?! You KNOW about the lag monster?!

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [serious] Juno... for thirty years, I was the night janitor... at the Server Farm.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [proud, mysterious] The place where all of Roblox lives.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [stunned] So the hundred keys...

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [proud] Ninety-nine of them open the Server Farm. [pause] One opens my locker. There's a sandwich in there from nineteen ninety-eight.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: Back then, the Lag was tiny. I'd shoo him away with my mop. But he feeds on traffic. The more everyone rushes at once... the bigger he gets.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [realizing] And today... the whole world is rushing at once.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: That's why they're shutting it all down. To starve him. Forever.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [determined] So if we stop the Lag... Roblox doesn't have to shut down?

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [grinning] Get your helmet, builder.
